answer_1.quote: Our data contain long and engaging spoken conversations between thousands of real-world Amazon Alexa customers and Gunrock, the 2018 Alexa Prize winning social bot... We select 3,608 ten-turn dialogs on movies...
datasets: Alexa Prize 2018 dialog dataset (3,608 ten-turn movie dialogs)
answer_1.outputs: Pairwise quality predictions indicating which of two dialogs provides a better user experience

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 400 dialog pairs for experts to annotate... Two researchers with conversational training experience annotated the data... They reached a high inter-annotator agreement score with kappa κ = 0.83.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked: "If you were the user, in which scenario would you be more likely to come back and talk to the system again?" They labeled 'A is better than B', 'B is better than A', or 'cannot tell'.
